name: OpenAI API
scope_notes: OpenAI API Platform organizations and projects (platform.openai.com); ChatGPT workspace and Codex credentials out of scope except where shared WIF docs mention them.

controls.name: API Key Governance
controls.what: Allow only service-account keys, only user-owned project keys, or disable all new API key creation at org or project level.

controls.name: Maximum API key lifetime
controls.what: New keys must expire within the configured limit; project limit cannot exceed org limit.

controls.name: IP allowlist
controls.what: Reject API requests from IPs outside up to 50 addresses/CIDRs; org or project level.

controls.name: Project API Keys permission (RBAC)
controls.what: Custom-role-eligible permission that lets a user manage their own API keys; assign roles without it to limit who can create keys.

controls.name: API key permissions (scopes)
controls.what: Key permissions are intersected with the owner's project role.

controls.name: Delete project API key
controls.what: Admin deletes a project key; takes effect within a few seconds.

controls.name: Workload Identity Provider and service account mappings
controls.what: Only tokens matching exactly one enabled mapping are exchanged; mapping permissions narrow access.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > Security > Workload Identity Provider

controls.name: Disable a workload identity service account mapping
controls.what: A disabled mapping makes token exchange fail for that service account, which stops new access tokens from being issued.
controls.setting: Workload Identity Provider > service account mapping (disabled state)

controls_unknown: Whether API keys are subject to SSO or IdP conditional access (no statement found).
Whether the IP allowlist covers Administration API calls made with admin keys.
Whether audit logging must be activated and its retention period (help center pages blocked to fetch).
Whether inference/data-read API calls (e.g. GET /v1/files) appear in the audit log; it is described as user actions and configuration changes.
Whether deleting a service account or WIF mapping invalidates already-issued WIF tokens before expiry.
Lifetime, listing and admin revocation of legacy user API keys.
API key secret prefix format (not stated in fetched docs).

authentication.summary: Static secret created in a project and sent as a bearer token. It acts for its owning user; its scopes are checked against the user's project role.

federation.details: OpenAI docs fetched do not say whether API keys are subject to SSO or IdP conditional access.

ip_restriction.boundary: Org or project IP allowlist applies to API requests made with the key. Does not cover dashboard sign-in. Changes take up to 15 minutes.

lifetime.summary: Optional expiry per key; admins can cap max lifetime per org/project

renewal.expiry_basis: expires_at set at creation, or null
renewal.summary: Create a replacement key and revoke the old one; full value shown only once.

administration.summary: Admins can list, update and delete project keys via the Administration API, restrict who can create keys through roles, and block user-owned key creation via API Key Governance.
administration.conditions: Governance only affects new keys. If the owner loses project access the key reports owner_project_access inactive.

offboard.details: Requests with a user-owned project key also require the owning user to hold a project role with the same permissions, so removing the user removes the key's effective access; the key record stays listed as owner access 'inactive' until deleted, and role changes take up to 30 minutes to propagate.

inventory.details: Admin API GET /v1/organization/projects/{project_id}/api_keys lists keys per project (owner_project_access=any includes keys whose owner lost access); iterate over projects.

offboard.ui: API Platform settings > People > Members > Remove > Confirm removal; project only: project Members page

token_format.notes: Not documented; only redacted_value is returned after creation.

log_sources.name: Audit logs (GET /v1/organization/audit_logs)
log_sources.notes: User actions and configuration changes; actor is session or api_key with key tracking id. Read with an admin key. Activation and retention not verified.

log_sources.name: Usage API (GET /v1/organization/usage/*)
log_sources.notes: Aggregated usage groupable by api_key_id; not per-request. Old pre-Dec-2023 keys may be untracked.

containment.steps: Delete the key in the dashboard or DELETE /v1/organization/projects/{project_id}/api_keys/{api_key_id}.
containment.notes: Revocations take effect within a few seconds.

unknown: Whether individual inference requests are logged anywhere customer-visible

authentication.summary: Workload exchanges an OIDC JWT, SPIFFE JWT-SVID or X.509 client cert at the token endpoint for a short-lived token mapped to a project service account.

federation.details: OIDC providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, OCI, SPIFFE) and X.509 via mTLS; mappings select the service account.

ip_restriction.boundary: Minted tokens are subject to the same IP allowlist checks as normal API requests.

lifetime.summary: At most 1 hour; never outlives the subject token or certificate

renewal.summary: No refresh token; repeat the exchange with a fresh external token.

administration.summary: Admins with permission configure Workload Identity Providers and service account mappings in Organization Settings > Security. Remove unused providers and mappings to cut off exchange.

inventory.details: No endpoint lists issued tokens; issuance appears in the audit log as tenant.workload_identity.access_token.issued.
